name: Agamand Mills
summary: Agamand Mills is a sprawling farm and windmill complex nestled in the northern heights of Tirisfal Glades. Once the proud estate of the wealthy Agamand dynasty, it has fallen into ruin and stands as the largest Scourge stronghold in the region.

sections.title: A House Divided
sections.body: The wealthy Agamand family built their estate around a vast milling network across northern Tirisfal. When the Third War broke out and the Scourge swept across Lordaeron, the patriarch Gregor Agamand refused to flee, fortifying the compound and convincing his retainers and laborers to make their stand. Their provisions and stone walls might have held, but their youngest son, Devlin Agamand, betrayed his blood. Devlin slaughtered the estate watchmen and let the walking dead into the sleeping quarters. Crippled from within, the remaining defenders were wiped out, and the family joined the mindless ranks of the undead.

sections.title: A Bastion of Rot
sections.body: Today, the Agamand Mills are the most entrenched bastion of the Scourge in Tirisfal Glades, posing an immediate threat to the Forsaken realm. The rotting windmills now churn above infested fields of wights, zombies, and skeletal horrors. Beneath the estate, Captain Dargol commands the garrison from the deep Agamand Family Crypt, practicing necromancy to reanimate generations of Agamand ancestors. From Brill, Magistrate Sevren and the Deathguards wage an active campaign to clear the mills and purge the Scourge presence before it can march upon the Undercity.

faq.q: Why is Agamand Mills overrun with Scourge?
aliases: why are there undead at the mills
faq.answer: When the Scourge ravaged Lordaeron, the Agamand family fortified their estate and attempted to hold out against the undead horde. However, the youngest son, Devlin Agamand, betrayed his family and opened the gates to the Scourge, leading to the slaughter and reanimation of everyone within.

faq.q: Who controls the mills right now?
aliases: who is in charge at the mills
faq.answer: The estate serves as a regional forward outpost for the Scourge, led by Captain Dargol. Dargol operates deep within the fortified Agamand Family Crypt, where he uses dark magic to raise ancestral corpses into new soldiers.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken care about this place?
faq.answer: The mills represent the largest concentration of mindless Scourge forces remaining in Tirisfal Glades. If left unchecked, Captain Dargol's force threatens Brill and could choke off roads leading south to the Undercity.

They were a wealthy human family of Lordaeron who owned the mills and the surrounding farmland in northern Tirisfal. Today, its reanimated scions—including Gregor, Nissa, Thurman, and Devlin—wander the grounds as mindless thralls.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, reclaiming Agamand Mills is not merely tactical—it is personal vengeance against the Scourge and a settling of scores by former estate servants like Coleman Farthing.
